subject: Eval gate delay incident and MAP containment
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.h@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Li <emma.l@lumenhealth.com>; Rajesh Singh <rajesh.s@lumenhealth.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.r@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.w@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 28 May 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Eval gate delay — proposed containment and MAP split

Hi Emma / Rajesh,

Thanks again for the sync this morning. Per the call, I want to summarize the immediate impact and propose a containment path so we don't slip the go-live window while procurement finishes the PO.

Summary:
- Lumen's procurement team has flagged an updated PO flow that requires reviewed SOW attachments and a separate security addendum; procurement indicated ~10 business days to complete.
- That pushes the current evaluation gate completion (annex sign-off) out by at least one week unless we take parallel steps.

Proposal (short term, low-friction):
1) MAP split — separate the acceptance criteria into a Functionality tranche (core inference path + basic observability) and a Compliance tranche (security addendum items: audit log retention, KMS integration details). Allow a limited production ingress for the Functionality tranche under a short-term conditional SLA.
2) Interim contract cover — we can issue a short-term letter of intent (LOI) acknowledging the tranche approach and preserving pricing/slots while Procurement completes PO.
3) Scoped deliverables — we will provide the required SOC2 evidence packet and a redline-friendly SOW within 48 hours (attached: MAP_v3_LumenHealth.xlsx).

Next steps: If Lumen agrees on the tranche approach I’ll draft the LOI and Camila will prepare the SOC2 packet and the compliance checklist for the compliance tranche. Jonas — can your team confirm resource hold and capacity for a staged rollout should Lumen want to enable the Functionality tranche next week?

Emma — can you confirm procurement's minimum gating condition for us to proceed with the tranche approach (e.g., is an LOI adequate, or do they insist on a signed PO before any traffic)?

Thanks,

Mina Haddad
Senior Manager, GTM
Redwood Inference
mina.h@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0191

Attachment: MAP_v3_LumenHealth.xlsx (contains proposed tranche acceptance matrix)

From: Emma Li <emma.l@lumenhealth.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.h@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rajesh Singh <rajesh.s@lumenhealth.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.r@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.w@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 28 May 2025 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Eval gate delay — proposed containment and MAP split

Mina — thanks for the clear summary.

Procurement note: LOI helps but does not replace our PO process. Our legal/procurement team requires either: 1) a PO with attached SOW + compliance addendum, or 2) an interim purchase authorization signed by budgeting and procurement (we call this a "PA") that allows limited spend < $25k for trials.

Practical ask: If we can go the PA route we can stand up the Functionality tranche to internal test users. But for any external-facing traffic or sustained throughput we will need the PO.

I will escalate internally now and loop procurement (procurement@lumenhealth.com). Rajesh — can you confirm whether finance will sign a PA for the pilot?

Emma
Director, Product — LumenHealth
emma.l@lumenhealth.com

Emma / Mina — FYI procurement has a backlog but PA is a possibility. I'll run numbers with finance this afternoon; need clarity on what 'limited spend' looks like operationally (monthly token estimate / expected spend) and whether Redwood will accept a PA for a 2-week trial window.

Mina — can you provide a simple one-page trial cost estimate (tokens per day x $/token x 14 days) and confirm whether toggling observability features affects billing materially?

Thanks,
Rajesh

rajesh.s@lumenhealth.com

From: Mina Haddad <mina.h@redwood.ai>
To: Rajesh Singh <rajesh.s@lumenhealth.com>, Emma Li <emma.l@lumenhealth.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.r@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.w@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 29 May 2025 08:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Eval gate delay — proposed containment and MAP split

Rajesh — thanks. Attached I’m sending a two-week trial cost estimate and a short note on observability toggles.

Summary (numbers):
- Estimated tokens/day (peak): 250k tokens/day
- Trial window: 14 days
- Unit price (trial rate preserved under LOI/PA): $0.0009 per token
- Estimated total spend (worst-case): 250k * 14 * 0.0009 = $3,150
- Observability delta: enabling full trace + extended retention increases cost ~20% in processing but we can cap retention to reduce delta to ~8%.

We will accept PA for a 2-week pilot and can sign a short LOI to hold pricing and capacity. Camila — please confirm SOC2 packet delivery ETA (we said 48 hours). Jonas — can you confirm we can freeze capacity and stand up the Functionality tranche by 2 Jun?

Best,
Mina

Attachment: Procurement_PO_template.pdf (procurement-friendly PO template)

From: Camila Reyes <camila.r@redwood.ai>

Date: Fri, 30 May 2025 15:02:00 -07:00

Hi all — sending SOC2 evidence packet and compliance tranche checklist this afternoon. Key redline items we expect from procurement: KMS key ownership, log retention SLA (90 days vs 365 days), and data residency clause.

I’ve attached the packet to this thread (see MAP_v3_LumenHealth.xlsx tab 'COMPLIANCE_EVIDENCE') and highlighted items that need procurement/legal sign-off. If procurement wants to accelerate, we can provide a scoped attestation for the pilot (controls in place, monitoring enabled) that narrows the immediate sign-off surface.

Jonas — per Mina’s ask: we have headroom, but to be safe we should reserve one mid-tier GPU node for Lumen during the pilot window. Can you confirm reservation and whether that impacts other scheduled pilots?

— Camila
Sr. Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
